features: Echo Show 8 (2nd Gen) with Alexa is an upgrade of our best-selling smart speaker with screen and comes with an improved 13 MP camera which you can use to make video calls to contacts having the Alexa app or Echo Show devices. You can control Echo Show 8 using only your voice. Alexa speaks English and Hindi.

Hands-free music control: Stream millions of songs in your favorite language from Amazon Prime Music, Spotify, JioSaavn, Gaana, and Apple Music. Enjoy singing along with on screen lyrics from Amazon Prime Music.
Your personal entertainment corner: Watch your favourite movies and TV shows from Amazon Prime Video and Netflix.
Monitor your home remotely: Activate the built-in camera remotely to securely monitor your home on your Alexa app or on other Echo Show devices.
Get started with Smart home: It is simple to make your home smart with Alexa and use voice to control lights, ACs, security cameras, TVs, geysers and more.

Stay in frame during video calls: Make video calls with the upgraded 13 MP camera that pans and zooms automatically to keep you in frame. Simply ask Alexa to call your friends and family who have the Alexa app or Echo Show devices. Use drop-in feature to check on your kids or parents just like an intercom.
Manage your day better: Just ask Alexa to set reminders and timers. Watch the latest news or get weather updates while you are rushing through your daily chores.
Designed to protect your privacy: Comes with a mic off button and a built-in camera cover.
description: Introducing Echo Show 8 (2nd Gen 2021 release) Echo Show 8 (2nd Gen) is an upgrade of our best-selling smart speaker with screen and has an 8-inch display that customers love, an improved 13 MP camera with auto framing feature, stereo sound and Alexa. Just ask Alexa to watch movies and TV Shows on Amazon Prime Video and Netflix, make video calls to other Alexa contacts, listen to music, control smart home devices, and much more. You can also use Echo Show 8’s camera to monitor your home remotely on your Alexa app or on other Echo Show devices.
